Package com.hkust.marketplace.utils

Class DealRequestService

java.lang.Object
com.hkust.marketplace.utils.DealRequestService
public final class DealRequestService extends Object
Make Deal Request (SRS UC-1.4): a buyer's price offer, borrow request or claim on a live listing. Each method checks the buyer and the listing, records the request through DealLifecycle (which validates the terms and saves it) and notifies the seller.

Refusals throw with a message for the buyer: SecurityException if the actor is not an active buyer, IllegalStateException if the listing is no longer available (A1) or the giveaway was already claimed (A4), and IllegalArgumentException for an invalid offer or borrow period (A2, A3).
